situation: My aunt Linda comments on my weight at every family dinner. I've deflected it at least five times. Thanksgiving is next month and I want to text her before then.
reply: Aunt Linda, I know you mean well, and I need you to stop commenting on my weight. It's off the table. I'd love to talk about anything else at Thanksgiving. See you on the 26th.
note: This is the firmer version; if it comes up at the table anyway, go help in the kitchen, no announcement.

situation: 每年过年大伯都当着一桌人问我一个月挣多少，我不想说，也不想让场面尴尬。
reply: 哈哈，大伯又来查账了。够我明年请您吃饭的。对了，您那个小菜园今年收成怎么样？听我爸说您种的辣椒特别好。
note: 如果他再问一次，用几乎一样的话再说一遍，一致比换花样更能让话题结束。

situation: 実家に帰るたびに母から「結婚はまだ？」と聞かれます。けんかにはしたくないけど、そろそろやめてほしい。
reply: お母さん、心配してくれてるのはわかってるよ。でも結婚の話はしばらくお休みにさせて。それ以外ならなんでも話したいから。そういえば、この前の旅行の写真見せてよ。
note: In many families a soft close like this is already firm; keep the blunter version for someone who keeps pushing.

situation: I finally texted my mum asking her to stop asking when I'm moving back to Manila. She replied 'So I can't even ask my own daughter anything now.' She sounds really hurt.
reply: Mum, I love you and I want our calls to be good ones. That's exactly why I'm asking for this one subject to rest. Ask me anything else, any time, and I'm still coming home for Christmas, my flight lands on the 19th.
note: When a parent hears the boundary as rejection, speak to the relationship, not the topic, and don't reopen the subject to comfort her.

situation: My husband's parents ask 'so when are you giving us a grandchild?' at every family dinner. We're in the middle of IVF and don't want to tell anyone yet. Diwali dinner is at their place in a few weeks.
reply: Ha, when there's news, you'll be the first to know, Mummy-ji. Now tell me, are you making the kaju katli yourself this year, or did Dev finally get the recipe out of you?
note: No reason given, since 'we're trying' invites advice; if it comes back, repeat the same line nearly word for word.

situation: My brother Mike and his wife just separated. Aunt Carol texted me 'So what really happened with Mike and Jen?? Was it her?' I'm not going to gossip about my brother.
reply: Hi Aunt Carol, that's Mike's story to tell, not mine, so I'll leave it with him. He's doing okay, and I know he'd love to hear from you directly. How's the kitchen renovation going?
note: When the nosy question is about someone else, decline on their behalf, point her to the person, and change the subject. No hints about who was at fault.

situation: 我在上海做游戏策划，干得挺开心。每次打电话我妈都劝我回老家考公务员，说图个稳定。国庆要回家待五天，我不想一回去就吵起来。
reply: 妈，我知道您是担心我，想让我稳当点。工作这块我现在挺好的，有什么变化第一个告诉您。对了，您上次说想学用手机拍视频，这次回去我教您，顺便给您和我爸拍几张好看的照片。
note: 不解释理由，解释就是在邀请对方给建议；她第二次问，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。
